title: Renamed Count
narrative: Total album count, but label the result column total_albums.
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE catalog (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, artist TEXT NOT NULL, genre TEXT, year INTEGER, price REAL);
seed_sql: INSERT INTO catalog VALUES (1,'Kind of Blue','Miles Davis','Jazz',1959,24.99),(2,'Thriller','Michael Jackson','Pop',1982,19.99),(3,'Led Zeppelin IV','Led Zeppelin','Rock',1971,22.50),(4,'Purple Rain','Prince','Funk',1984,18.99),(5,'Nevermind','Nirvana','Rock',1991,21.00),(6,'Dark Side of the Moon','Pink Floyd','Rock',1973,25.99),(7,'Born to Run','Bruce Springsteen','Rock',1975,20.00),(8,'Rumours','Fleetwood Mac','Pop',1977,21.99),(9,'Blue','Joni Mitchell','Folk',1971,19.50),(10,'Whats Going On','Marvin Gaye','Soul',1971,22.00);

hints.content: Combine COUNT(*) with AS to name the result column.
Try: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_albums FROM catalog
